// Ledger: one folio per booking — what was charged, what was paid in cash, what was paid in points.
signal pay_points(folio: String, amount: Int) -> Int   // Ledger
    // The same, paid with points (the caller has already taken the points).
    requires amount >= 1
writes     points_paid: Map<String, Int> [persistent]   // folio -> total paid with points, cents
               invariant points_paid >= 0
calls      due(folio: String) -> Int   reads cash, charged, points_paid
               // charged - cash - points_paid; 0 for an unknown folio.
called by  Desk.settle_with_points
